thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for `gpu-host-nyc-17` (kernel_panic -> kubelet NotReady). Priority: P1. Autopage: true. Page: https://pagers.example/incident/INC-7812349990 :rotating_light:

alex-ops: acked. I'm on it. pulling serial console now.

incident-bot: Auto-escalation in 2m if not acknowledged by a human.

marie-sre: thanks alex — if kubelet is NotReady for >5m we should cordon+drain and failover tenants. any obvious customer impact?

alex-ops: quick check: `kubectl get nodes gpu-host-nyc-17 -o wide` shows `NotReady` and `10.2.17.45`. Logs from serial show kernel oops and then `watchdog: hung` lines. snippet:

```
Sep 14 02:11:03 kernel: RIP: 0010:panic+0x1a/0x2f
Sep 14 02:11:04 kernel: Kernel panic - not syncing: watchdog: BUG: soft lockup
Sep 14 02:11:07 systemd[1]: Stopping User Manager for UID 1000...
```

devon: fwiw there are 3 pods Pending that were pinned to this host (tenant-cart-replicas). Could be impacting a small set of seats. Count: 4 pods in CrashLoopBackOff, 2 nodes scheduled on this host only.

sam-platform: tagging product: cart-service — notif sent to oncall-product (cart-oncall). ETA for failover?

alex-ops: trying soft-reboot via IPMI now: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.2.17.10 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle`. If that fails will request rack ops RMA.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: event had duplicate pages due to retry loop; deduped to single incident.

marie-sre: alex, please cordon first to prevent new pods landing: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-nyc-17` then attempt drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Post outputs here.

alex-ops: cordon done. drain started:

```
kubectl cordon gpu-host-nyc-17
node/gpu-host-nyc-17 cordoned

kubectl drain gpu-host-nyc-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
WARNING: ignoring DaemonSet-managed pods: kube-system/node-exporter-*, kube-system/nvidia-drivers-*
evicting pod cart-api-7f6d...
evicting pod model-worker-2x9...
```

ops-rack: received request for rack-level power cycle. IPMI logs show host responded to chassis power command but kernel didn't recover. Recommend physical reset/cage check.

devon: customer-impact update: cart-service degraded for 12 users across two customers. No overall platform-wide outage. Logging teams notified.

marie-sre: escalated to oncall-lead (sam-platform) to greenlight RMA if hardware not responding in 15m. Also email SOC for possible data-sensitivity check (compute tenancy).

sam-platform: oncall-lead here. good playbook so far. If IPMI reset doesn't return kubelet Ready in 10m, approve RMA and schedule node replacement with minimal tenant disruption. Also set temporary quota to reduce bin-packing on racks.

alex-ops: IPMI power cycle completed at 02:22Z. Serial shows kernel re-initializing, then `systemd[1]: Started Kubernetes Kubelet.`

```
Sep 14 02:24:13 kubelet[1234]: NodeReady status changed to Ready
Sep 14 02:24:14 kubelet[1234]: Registered node gpu-host-nyc-17 with controller manager
```

alex-ops: kubelet now Ready. uncordoning to allow scheduling.

marie-sre: hold — do not uncordon until we confirm node health & NVMe SMART checks. we saw previous intermittent nvme errors. alex run `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1` and paste.

alex-ops: smartctl shows reallocated sectors non-zero but within threshold. posting snippet:

```
SMART overall-health self-assessment test result: PASSED
Reallocated_Sector_Ct: 15
Media_Error_Count: 0
Error_Count: 3
```

devon: recommend mark node as `needs-hardware-review` and keep cordoned for now; let autoscaler fill from reserved pool.

sam-platform: agree. I'll update incident on PagerDuty: resolved by reboot but follow-up RMA/tech investigation ticket required.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-7812349990 marked RESOLVED by sam-platform (manual). Duration: 18m.

marie-sre: summary for postmortem: kernel panic triggered watchdog -> kubelet NotReady; reboot restored services; NVMe shows early warning signs. Next steps: open ticket to schedule NVMe replacement on next maintenance window, add hardware health alert threshold for Reallocated_Sector_Ct > 10, add playbook step to check `smartctl` before uncordon.

alex-ops: putting short checklist here for follow-up:
- open internal ticket: HW-781234 (ops-rack)
- notify cart-oncall and affected customers with timeline
- add eval to Optimize to catch this pod placement anti-pattern (pinned pods)

devon: adding note: customer-impact: 12 active users affected for ~18m, no data loss reported.

sam-platform: handing off to day team for full RCA. I'm leaving a final note in the incident channel. nice quick response team. :white_check_mark:

marie-sre: handing to day shift — closing oncall rotation. follow-ups assigned to ops-rack and infra-triage.

alex-ops: thanks all.
